statement: Improve frozen-encoder OOD detection through geometric alignment and calibrated safety gating. Use experiment-backed meta-review feedback to refine the method, adopting only strict empirical improvements.

directions.title: geometric alignment
directions.description: Improve class-conditional covariance geometry with a reproducible alignment mechanism.

directions.title: calibrated safety gating
directions.description: Calibrate a no-harm fallback to the frozen detector and test the gate using ablations.

audience_note: Offline simulated meta-review fixture; measured improvement remains the only adoption gate.
